Task: Frostiez had a fun, flavor-forward brand foundation, but its visual identity and packaging didn’t fully express that energy. The logo felt dated, the style lacked unity, and the product lineup needed a clear creative direction to strengthen recognition across all categories.
Solution: We reimagined Frostiez from the ground up, refreshing the brand identity, creating a complete packaging system, and building a unified visual world that reflects its bold, playful, flavor-rich personality.
Rebranding: A modern, lighter logo, brighter color palette, and comic-inspired style bring movement, personality, and instant recognizability. The new identity positions Frostiez as expressive, fun, and confidently vibrant.
Packaging: We created a full packaging ecosystem for the entire product lineup: top-shelf flower, sungrown flower, shake, premium flower, pre-rolls, single pre-roll tubes, premium concentrates, and all-in-one vapes.
Master Cases: The next step was creating master cases for all product types to ensure impactful shelf presence and product showcase in retail areas.
Glass Jar: For this indoor flower line, we designed premium glass jar packaging paired with custom labels and original illustrations for every strain.

Instead of relying on predictable visuals or generic strain descriptions, each illustration was created to visually express the unique feeling, mood, and character of the strain itself. The result is packaging that turns every jar into a small piece of visual storytelling.
Pre-Rolls: Every category received custom illustrations, flavor-driven color palettes, and clean, structured layouts designed to enhance shelf impact and reinforce a cohesive, instantly recognizable family look across the full Frostiez catalog.
Single Pre-Roll Tube & Master Case: We designed a single pre-roll tube that carries the full Frostiez look in a compact format, with custom illustrations and flavor-driven colors on every tube. A matching master case groups the tubes for retail, giving the line the same bold shelf presence as the rest of the catalog.
Premium Concentrate: For the premium concentrate line, we brought Frostiez’s playful energy into a more elevated category. Refined layouts, rich color, and signature illustrations signal top-tier quality while staying unmistakably Frostiez.
All-in-One Vape: All 25 Frostiez all-in-one vape flavors feature custom illustrations, child-resistant packaging, and uniquely designed devices, creating a bold, collectible, and flavorful experience.

For all-in-one vape, we built everything from the ground up. The device features a fully custom body and display, paired with premium child-resistant double packaging and a clean, easy-to-follow instruction insert. Every detail was crafted for a polished, high-end consumer experience.
Social Media / Weedmaps: We designed a full visual rollout for Frostiez on Weedmaps, creating eye-catching brand banners and impactful custom product photography that stands out across the platform.

Our goal was simple: make Frostiez impossible to scroll past. Through bold visuals and carefully crafted product images, we helped the brand capture attention instantly and elevate its presence on the largest cannabis marketplace.

Task: Happy Botanist produced high-quality, lab-tested cannabis, but the brand lacked a visual identity that communicated its natural purity, scientific precision, and premium positioning.
Solution: A new identity system was created to express trust, transparency, and refined quality. Subtle THC molecule motifs highlight the scientific backbone of the brand, while dark minimalistic visuals elevate its premium feel.
Brand Identity: A minimal, science-inspired identity built around molecular patterns, clean geometry, and a refined palette. It signals precision, natural quality, and a premium, trustworthy character.
Naming: We developed the naming Happy Botanist to capture a balance of professionalism, trust, and feel-good energy. The name evokes high-quality craftsmanship, positivity, and a modern, approachable cannabis experience rooted in expertise and care.
Packaging: Dark, elegant packaging with transparent product windows and subtle molecular symbolism. Designed for clarity, purity, and premium shelf presence while staying true to the brand’s natural and lab-tested ethos.
Single Pre-Roll: The single pre-roll brings Happy Botanist’s dark, minimal language to a compact format. Subtle molecular details and clean typography keep it precise and premium, carrying the same trusted, lab-tested character as the full line.
Concentrate: Concentrate packaging extends the brand’s scientific backbone into a new category. THC molecule motifs, a refined dark palette, and clear product information communicate purity and quality at a glance.

Task: Frost Cannabis Delivery needed a brand identity that captured its fun, vibrant personality while standing out in a crowded delivery market.
Solution: A full brand identity and logo was created with a signature melting effect that evokes summer heat, flavor, and a playful sense of craving. The visuals are crisp, colorful, and instantly recognizable across every platform, making Frost impossible to miss.
Social Media: Frost’s bright and energetic aesthetic comes to life on major platforms like Weedmaps through eye-catching banners and scroll-stopping posts. The content feels refreshing, mouthwatering, and full of movement, turning every placement into a moment that draws users in and sparks curiosity.
Delivery Bag: Bold graphics, bright colors, and the melting motif make the delivery bag eye-catching, playful, and instantly recognizable, perfectly reflecting Frost’s energetic personality.

Task: Weeed needed a bold, modern identity that reflected its wide product selection and positioned the shop as a premium, go-to cannabis destination.
Solution: A complete visual system was developed, including a logo, brand identity, and custom design assets that highlight variety, quality, and an elevated shopping experience. A distinctive trolley-inspired logo communicates Weeed’s role as the ultimate one-stop cannabis shop.
Brand Identity: A dynamic, energetic identity built on bold visuals, modern patterns, and a clean, expressive style. The brand communicates freedom, enjoyment, and a vibrant shopping culture.
Social Media: High-impact visuals that strengthen presence both in-store and online. Clean compositions, strong messaging, and bold graphics highlight product variety and boost visibility.

Task: Many cannabis delivery services operate with minimal brand identity, resulting in experiences that feel anonymous and purely transactional. For Call The Queens, the objective was to create a brand that could transform ordering into a memorable cultural experience.
Solution: We developed the complete concept behind Call The Queens, including the naming, narrative structure, characters, and visual identity. Rather than positioning the service around products, the brand reframes ordering as an interaction with a personality. Customers call a Queen who represents the mood they want to experience.

Three characters define the brand universe: Haze, Lumi, and Selenia, each representing a distinct emotional state. This structure transforms the delivery process into a ritual while creating opportunities for storytelling, collectibles, loyalty systems, and community-driven experiences.
Brand Concept & Characters: The name Call The Queens establishes the foundation of the brand narrative. Instead of browsing product categories, customers choose the Queen that reflects their desired mood or experience.

Haze represents energy, sociability, and high-vibe moments. Lumi represents brightness, playfulness, and uplifting moods. Selenia represents calm, introspection, and relaxed experiences. These personalities act as emotional guides within the brand system and provide a consistent framework for visual communication, campaigns, and future storytelling.
Gamification & Community: The concept expands into a gamified loyalty structure designed to strengthen engagement and encourage repeat orders.
Queen Mood Points reward customers for ordering within specific moods, unlocking perks and experiences associated with each Queen.

Each delivery also includes collectible Queen cards or stickers. Completing collections unlocks benefits such as discounts, VIP access, or limited releases, transforming deliveries into collectible moments that reinforce brand engagement.

The brand ecosystem further extends into community-driven experiences such as roller-skate parties, art drops, and live DJ pop-ups, allowing the Queens to exist beyond digital platforms and strengthening cultural relevance.
Social Media: We built the brand’s social media around the Queens themselves. Haze, Lumi, and Selenia front the content, with mood-driven posts and character moments that make the feed feel like an ongoing story rather than a product list.
Delivery Bags: Branded delivery bags bring the Queens’ world to the customer’s door. Bold color, the crown mark, and spray-paint textures turn every handoff into a recognizable brand moment.
Delivery Mylar Bags: Custom mylar bags carry the identity onto the product itself. Vivid graphics and character details keep every order on-brand, making the unboxing part of the collectible experience.
Website Design: The website is designed around the brand’s core idea: choosing a Queen instead of browsing a catalog. Visitors pick a mood, meet the Queen behind it, and order through an experience that feels personal, playful, and easy to navigate.
Coming Soon Game Concept: For the pre-launch phase, we developed a Coming Soon game concept built around spray painting. Visitors pick up a virtual spray can and tag the wall in the brand’s street-art style, turning the wait for launch into a playful, hands-on introduction to the Queens.

Task: A brand built on human connection had no visual system that conveyed it. Hardy’s needed a powerful symbol, strong shelf presence, and a unified identity that felt warm, social, and unmistakably theirs.
Solution: We reimagined the brand through the language of hands, crafting an iconic “H” from Michelangelo-inspired gestures and extending the idea into patterns, packaging, and merch. The result: a bold, cohesive identity that radiates unity, optimism, and instant recognition.
The “Gesture + Color” Concept: We transformed Hardy’s hand symbolism into a full product-coding system. Each product category gets its own gesture and dedicated color, creating a clear, cohesive, and instantly recognizable identity across the entire lineup.
Packaging: Hardy’s packaging delivers attitude and clarity. Unique gestures and colors define each strain, creating strong shelf impact and a bold, unified look that feels rebellious yet refined.
Merchandise: We brought Hardy’s spirit into physical form with expressive graphics, signature colors, and premium materials. Every piece extends the brand’s identity with confidence, energy, and lasting quality.

Task: Canabotanica needed a clearer visual system to organize its growing product range and move the brand into a more modern, premium space.
Solution: A precise, streamlined design language was created to improve clarity and hierarchy across all formats. Mylar bags, glass jars, and tin boxes were redesigned for stronger communication and shelf presence. The CABO logo was enhanced with category-specific icons placed inside the O, making navigation intuitive while keeping the brand cohesive.
Brand Identity: A refined, minimal aesthetic built on crisp typography, balanced layouts, and a premium tone. The adaptive logo adds a functional layer of storytelling, giving each category its own subtle signature without breaking consistency.
Packaging: A unified packaging ecosystem covering flower (indica, sativa, hybrid), pre-rolls, and rosin (standard and premium). Each line features its own color logic, clean structure, and elevated materials to enhance visibility and recognition. From bags and boxes to jars and tins, every product was crafted to feel modern and unified.
Packaging (Concentrates & Rosin): Premium concentrates and rosin use clean layouts, refined materials, and subtle accents to convey quality and craftsmanship in a modern, premium package.

Task: Sunset needed a full-scale rebrand to unify its presence across social media, Weedmaps, web, and retail. The challenge was to redesign the brand while preserving its roots, creating a cohesive, recognizable system with a warm, modern, and social feel.
Solution: We developed a complete rebranding and retail design system for Sunset, combining logo refinement with a full redesign of the store interior.

The updated identity introduces a cleaner, more modern logotype supported by a fresh visual direction. This new aesthetic was translated into a redesigned retail concept centered around a premium flower island centerpiece that serves as the focal point of the space.

The interior layout was carefully developed through detailed measurements, spatial planning, and renders to guide customer flow naturally through the store while maximizing product exposure and visual impact.
Brand Identity: The Sunset logo redesign focused on evolving a well-recognized identity while preserving the brand’s familiar essence. Rather than replacing the original mark, the goal was to refine it into a cleaner, more modern, and highly scalable system suitable for both digital and physical applications. The palm icon was refined to achieve a sharper, more balanced visual presence while maintaining the recognizable symbolism valued by existing customers.
Digital & Platform Presence: To ensure brand consistency across digital platforms, we designed a series of Weedmaps banners aligned with the new identity, maintaining the same clean, bright visual language used in the store.
Interactive Game: As part of the rollout, we created a Coming Soon website experience featuring an interactive basketball mini-game designed and developed specifically for the pre-launch phase. The game invited visitors to engage with the brand in a playful way while building anticipation for the upcoming release.

This digital teaser was supported by a Coming Soon social media campaign, including a series of posts and reels that gradually revealed elements of the new identity. Together, the interactive website and social content worked to generate curiosity, engage the audience, and build momentum leading up to the official branding launch.
Website: The new Sunset website is built around a signature palm scroll effect, with the palm moving through the page alongside 3D models as visitors scroll. Renders and a full 3D model of the shop bring the redesigned retail space online, so customers can explore the store before they visit.
Retail Engagement & Promotions: To enhance the in-store experience, we developed a custom promotional game designed specifically for the retail space. The interactive concept encourages customer participation during promotions and increases engagement within the store.

Task: Sunset needed its own product line, one that stays connected to the retail brand but stands on its own. The challenge was to build a warm, laid-back and premium identity from scratch.
Solution: We created Sunset Collection from the ground up, including the name, logo, packaging and visual world, all inspired by the California sunset.
Brand Identity: The brand initials, a palm tree and the sun come together in one bold mark. The palm cuts through the letters and the “C” becomes a setting sun.
Packaging: Retro stripes, palm silhouettes and a color for each strain type (orange for sativa, blue for indica, green for hybrid) bring the California mood to the shelf. Pre-rolls, vape cartridges and shake are now in development.
